name: Vela Spark
title: Live Wire
description: A street electrician who fights like a short circuit: twitchy footsies, then a bolt down the lane.
source_description: Female fighter, athletic, short copper hair, yellow utility jacket, sparking personality, lightning-based powers.
special_desc: A fast bolt that wins footsies from mid-screen.
ultimate_desc: Drops the whole lane into a white-out surge.
